draft.title: Arthur Verocai
draft.text: Listen for the strings: Verocai arranged this 1972 record like a film score, and the rhythm section plays samba-jazz under it. Start with Na Boca do Sol.

draft.title: Linha do Horizonte
draft.text: The Fender Rhodes sounds like it is floating. At the two-minute mark the samba groove drops out and the synth takes over; that moment is the reason to play it.
This is one of my favourite records of all time and everyone I know should hear it at least once in their life.
